CURRENT CI ATTESTATION for the gates criterion (supersedes any earlier patchset evidence on this ticket).

Change 1048 ('9249: grant the review bot Bedrock access'), PATCHSET 4, commit 66c8b9b9c5d934972054a0035e06a345e1193a43:
- Verified +1 (rebar CI bot) — SUCCESS
- LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot) — PASS

Patchset 4 is the one carrying ALL of this story's remediation: the policy moved out of iam.tf into the new infra/terraform/iam_s7.tf, the runbook cross-reference corrected to name iam_s7.tf, and the streaming verification recipe added as runbook section 3. Earlier patchsets (ps1-ps2) predate that work; ps2 in particular carried a Verified -1 that was a STALE copied vote from before bug 9f0b/change 1050 merged, cleared by a recheck — it does not describe this patchset.

Local gates on the same tree: iam.tf is byte-identical to its pre-S7 state (git diff HEAD~1 -- infra/terraform/iam.tf is empty), terraform fmt -check clean, and both resource addresses are unchanged in the same module so Terraform sees no diff — meaning the production grant is untouched and the from-instance verification recorded above still describes the deployed state.

Plan-review attestation: PASS, 0 blocking, 1 advisory, signed at head_sha 66c8b9b9c5d934972054a0035e06a345e1193a43.
